## Texas Affinity - Affinity APP

### Project Overview:
Built a CRM application for an insurance company with React, Laravel and MariaDB. The application included a data import feature that significantly enhanced overall productivity by reducing to 0% the necessity of sending informative emails.

### Tasks and Activities:

- Task 1: Description of the first major task or activity
- Task 2: Description of the second major task or activity
- Task 3: Description of the third major task or activity

### Achievements:

- **Successfully developed a comprehensive CRM solution for an insurance company**
- **Implemented a data import feature that eliminated the need for informative emails**
- **Enhanced overall productivity through streamlined data management processes**

### Technologies/Tech Stack:
**React, TypeScript, PHP, Laravel, MariaDB, REST APIs, SQL, MySQL, Object-Oriented Programming**

document.title: Why I've switched from WordPress to Next.js to create my personal website?
document.summary: In the middle of 2021, I did some research to do a redesign of my personal website. This one was starting to get pretty old...

body.raw:
<Image
  alt={`From WordPress to Nextjs`}
  src={`/static/images/wp-nextjs/from-wp-to-nextjs.jpg`}
  width={1920 / 2}
  height={1080 / 2}
  priority
/>

In the middle of 2021, I did some research to do a redesign of my personal website. This one was starting to get pretty old, I had created it in 2019 during my search for an apprenticeship contract in an effort to stand out from the crowd. It was built on the most used and popular CMS in the world: [WordPress](https://wordpress.org/). It was running on one of the most popular themes: [Divi](https://www.elegantthemes.com/) from **Elegant Theme**. As a Divi fan, I found that it didn't really fit me anymore and I was looking for a **new challenge**.

## How I discovered Next.js?

During the research I came across many **inspiring personal websites** and these websites had one thing in common:

- Fluidity and speed of execution
- Minimalist design

They also had another thing in common, they were running on [Next.js](https://nextjs.org), a framework based on [React](https://reactjs.org/). During my research I also found that they were very efficient from an SEO point of view. Google with its Page Lighthouse module rates almost all sites based on Next.js with scores between 90 and 100 in the 4 different rating criteria.

Here is a list of my favorite portfolios & personal websites:

- [Brian Lovin](https://brianlovin.com/)
- [Nev Flynn](https://nevflynn.com/)
- [Rauno](https://rauno.me/)
- [Marc Bouchenoire](https://marcbouchenoire.com/)
- [Lee Rob](https://leerob.io/)

### Here is a comparison of my old site vs the new one:

<Image
  alt={`Google Lighthouse camparison`}
  src={`/static/images/wp-nextjs/google-lighthouse-wordpress-vs-next.jpg`}
  width={1920 / 2}
  height={1080 / 2}
  priority
/>

## How did I learn the basics of JavaScript and Next?

As mentioned above, I've been working on WordPress for **more than 6 years now**, so I've been a low-code user. But in any case I was able to acquire good technical bases with the use of HTML and CSS.

I still had to learn more about Nextjs, I naturally trained myself with the resources available on the **Next website**. There's a pretty good [tutorial](https://nextjs.org/learn/foundations/about-nextjs) to build your first application with **Next**. The tutorial covers the basics, such as **HTML, CSS and JavaScript**.

Afterwards I also discovered that Next was followed by a large community of developers. It also allows to ask for advices and to receive good practices. While exploring the many themes of the community, I came across a very promising template : [Tailwind nextjs starter blog template](https://github.com/timlrx/tailwind-nextjs-starter-blog) from [`@timlrx`](https://github.com/timlrx).

I really appreciated this sharing of information in a very transparent way. It allows everyone to **start a project on Nextjs** without being an _experienced developer_. On the other hand I think that you still need some essential soft skills:

- Be curious and open minded
- Not to be afraid to turn in circles
- Know how to handle unknown problems

## Free hosting with Vercel.

Another interesting feature with Nextjs is the possibility to host your website on [Vercel](https://vercel.com) for **free**. Indeed, Vercel offers **free hosting** for non-commercial & hobby sites.

## Final word.

Any good marketer needs to be curious and open-minded. Learning the basics of Nextjs and JavaScript coding will undoubtedly benefit me all along my career.

Especially on these 3 aspects:

- Work more efficiently with technical teams and especially know how to clearly express expectations and needs during a complex project.
- Have a much more user-centered vision.
- Improve my ability to solve problems and be more persistent in my work.

## Tools used for the creation of the website:

document.summary: In 2018 as part of its new brand strategy, Havana Club made a collaboration with a French artist: VALD.

In 2018 as part of its **new brand strategy**, Havana Club made a collaboration with a French artist: **VALD**. The opportunity for the artist to create **his first bottle with his signature design.**

## A unique collaboration:

As part of this new collaboration in 2018, I had the opportunity to work closely with the Digital Manager in the implementation of this project.

I was involved in several operational aspects and in the management of the project:

document.summary: CRM solution for a major insurance provider, integrating Django, React, and Postgres. Focused on secure data handling, optimized database queries, and streamlined historical data processing.

body.raw:
## Texas Seguros | Contract Software Engineer  
**March 2020 – August 2020**  

### Project Overview:  
Developed a CRM solution for a major insurance provider, integrating Django, React, and Postgres. Ensured secure data handling for millions of users, optimized database queries, and streamlined complex historical data processing tasks.  

### Tasks and Activities:  

- Architected and implemented back-end services in Django and Django REST Framework to manage policy data and user records.  
- Created responsive front-end components in React, improving user experience and reducing navigation friction.  
- Tuned database queries to cut request times by half, increasing system responsiveness and reliability.  

### Achievements:  

- **Substantial Cost Savings:** Delivered a system that saved the company millions of dollars annually by improving data management and operational efficiency.  
- **Data Integrity and Efficiency:** Reduced processing times by 40% through query optimization and code refactoring.  

### Technologies/Tech Stack:  
**Python, Django, React, PostgreSQL, REST APIs**

document.summary: Since 2021, I have been working with TotalEnergies Lubricants teams to create & develop graphic guidelines...

body.raw:
<Image

**TotalEnergies Lubricants** is a world leader in the production and distribution of **lubricants for consumers, industry, agriculture and transportation professionals.** The company has 41 production sites throughout the world and employs more than 5,800 people in 150 countries.

## A Graphic Design Project.

Since 2021, I have been working with TotalEnergies Lubricants teams to create & develop graphic guidelines, information documents, packshots and labels.

<Image
  alt={`From WordPress to Nextjs`}
  src={`/static/images/projects/ELF-BROCHURE.png`}
  width={1080 / 2}
  height={1080 / 2}
  priority
/>

## Achievements:

To meet the client's expectations, I worked in a **collaborative way** using Microsoft Teams, SharePoint & Adobe Creative Cloud. This work method allowed me to be as **efficient and agile as possible** in order to provide the highest level of satisfaction. I was able to stand out in the speed of execution of the deliverables ordered by the client.

document.title: Toy Surfboards, design and creation of an e-commerce website
document.summary: Creation, configuration and development of an e-commerce website on WordPress for a famous surfboard shaper

body.raw:
<Image
  alt={`ToySurfboards Website`}
  src={`/static/images/projects/browser_toy.png`}
  width={1336 / 2}
  height={827 / 2}
  priority
/>

[Toy Surfboards](https://toysurfboards.com/) is a surfboard brand created by [Didier DAMESTOY](https://toysurfboards.com/didier-damestoy-shaper/). Shaper since 1985, Didier designs his creations according to a singular method, combining science and intuition, resulting from a knowledge of fluid mechanics.

## Creation & design of a e-commerce website.

Creation, configuration and development of an e-commerce website on [WordPress.org](https://fr.wordpress.org/) with the [WooCommerce](https://woocommerce.com/) extension.

### Website goals:

- Gain awareness in France
- Increase customer engagement
- Create a responsive website that is effective on both mobile and computer
- Create a "Shop" space to effectively display the products available for sale
- Include "Click & Collect" functionality

<Image
  alt={`ToySurfboards Website`}
  src={`/static/images/projects/ToySurfboards-Laptop.png`}
  width={1500 / 2}
  height={1234 / 2}
  priority
/>

## Achievements:

To meet the expectations of the customer, I structured the site to make it **readable, accessible and engaging**. The objective is to **highlight the brand Toy Surfboards and the expertise of Didier DAMESTOY**, to include the entire catalog in order to allow the customer to **navigate quickly on the site** and choose his custom surfboard adapted to **his desires and abilities**. I also accompanied Toy Surfboards in the development of an **Instagram Shop**.

**All the pages of the site meet the standards and recommendations of websites:**

- Both in terms of SEO
- Adaptable on different supports (mobile, tablet, computer)
- In overall performance
- In security
